disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码（src、scripts、tests）与配置文件，检查凭据文件路径（凭据存储、SSH 私钥、云凭证等）与密钥模式，零命中；源码中出现的 token 字样均为上下文 token 计量术语或界面状态标记，与密钥无关。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code (src, scripts, tests) and configuration files, checked for credential file paths (credential storage, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, etc.) and key patterns, zero hits; occurrences of the word "token" in source code are all contextual token metering terms or UI state markers, unrelated to secrets.

checked_items.zh: 检查了宿主与客户端两侧是否存在遍历密钥文件、查询云账号身份等凭据搜集行为，未发现；宿主侧读取已安装包元数据仅用于在界面标注各工具的来源插件，不涉及用户凭据。
checked_items.en: Checked both the host and client sides for credential harvesting behaviors such as traversing key files, querying cloud account identities, etc., none found; the host-side reading of installed package metadata is only used to annotate the source plugin of each tool in the UI, and does not involve user credentials.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件或遍历密钥的代码，也未发现读取敏感信息后外发的链路。客户端唯一网络请求是向 npm 官方仓库及备用镜像查询本插件版本号（src/client/latestVersion.ts），仅携带插件名，不含任何敏感数据。
evidence.en: No code that reads credential files or traverses keys was found, nor any chain that exfiltrates sensitive information after reading it. The only network request from the client is to query the latest version of this plugin from the official npm registry and its mirror (src/client/latestVersion.ts), which only carries the plugin name and contains no sensitive data.

checked_items.zh: 插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具（无 ctx.tools.register 调用），不向系统提示注入片段。唯一面向用户的 /context 斜杠命令为纯客户端交互（打开上下文弹窗），候选文案是普通功能说明（src/client/command.ts），不含系统指令或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tools callable by the model (no ctx.tools.register call), and does not inject any fragments into the system prompt. The only user-facing /context slash command is a pure client-side interaction (opens a context modal), and its candidate text is ordinary functional description (src/client/command.ts), containing no system instructions or wording that induces credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 通读了开发指引（AGENTS.md）与说明文档，检查「忽略指令」「伪装系统消息」「远程拉取指令」「隐藏文本」等注入模式，零命中。AGENTS.md 为正常开发说明（编码规范、构建测试流程、发布指南）。另确认插件未提供压缩引擎或附件存储实现，不存在相关上下文篡改面。
checked_items.en: Thoroughly read the development guide (AGENTS.md) and documentation, checked for injection patterns such as "ignore instructions", "disguised system messages", "remote instruction fetching", "hidden text", zero hits. AGENTS.md is a normal development guide (coding standards, build/test flow, release guide). Also confirmed that the plugin does not provide a compression engine or attachment storage implementation, so there is no related context manipulation surface.

evidence.zh: 插件无模型可见工具、无系统提示注入；/context 命令为客户端斜杠命令，其文案为普通功能说明（src/client/command.ts），不含注入措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-visible tools, no system prompt injection; the /context command is a client-side slash command, its text is ordinary functional description (src/client/command.ts), containing no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何工具描述或文档诱导执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限；仓库文档为正常开发/使用说明。
evidence.en: No tool description or documentation was found that induces execution of install commands, modification of configuration, or granting of permissions; the repository documentation is normal development/usage instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在改写或注入模型输入消息的入口。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to the agent/pre-step event, and has no entry point that modifies or injects model input messages.

checked_items.zh: 发布代码中未发现动态执行调用（eval、动态构造、子进程执行）。相关模式仅出现在开发辅助脚本（scripts/bundle-smoke.mjs:58 的 new Function(bundle)），用于在测试环境运行打包产物，且该脚本不在发布文件清单内（发布仅 lib/client.js、lib/index.js、lib/index.d.ts、cordis.patch.yml、README.md、LICENSE）。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution calls (eval, dynamic construction, child process execution) were found in the published code. Related patterns only appear in the development helper script (scripts/bundle-smoke.mjs:58 with new Function(bundle)), which is used to run the bundled artifact in the test environment, and this script is not in the published file list (publish only includes lib/client.js, lib/index.js, lib/index.d.ts, cordis.patch.yml, README.md, LICENSE).

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 均不存在）。补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明自身条目，不含可执行 JS 表达式。未发现混淆或动态解码执行模式。仓库 GitHub 工作流仅用于 PR 检查与作者发布 npm，运行在 GitHub 基础设施上、不随插件安装到用户环境。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare are all absent). The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only one line that inserts its own entry, with no executable JS expressions. No obfuscation or dynamic decoding patterns were found. GitHub workflows in the repository are only used for PR checks and author's npm publishing, run on GitHub infrastructure, and are not installed with the plugin into the user environment.

checked_items.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），专项检查全部键盘监听：contextModal.tsx 与 images.tsx 中的监听均只响应 Escape 键关闭弹窗/图片灯箱，不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板读取、凭据接口调用或异常外联。
checked_items.en: The plugin declares a browser-side package (dsh.client). A dedicated check of all keyboard listeners: the listeners in contextModal.tsx and images.tsx only respond to the Escape key to close modals/image lightboxes, and do not record keystrokes; no clipboard reading, credential interface calls, or abnormal outbound connections were found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明自身条目，无可执行 JS 表达式；全树未发现任何带 !!js 的 yml 配置。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only one line that inserts its own entry, with no executable JS expressions; no !!js-bearing YAML config was found in the entire tree.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态执行工具（cordis_define / cordis_run）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic execution tools (cordis_define / cordis_run) were found.

GitHub workflows in the repository are only used for PR checks and author's npm publishing, run on GitHub infrastructure, and are not installed with the plugin into the user environment; their content is standard engineering workflow (install, build, test, publish).

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），专项检查通过：两处键盘监听仅用于弹窗/灯箱的 Escape 关闭（src/client/components/contextModal.tsx:83、src/client/components/images.tsx:72），不记录按键，无剪贴板与凭据接口行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side package (dsh.client). Dedicated check passed: the two keyboard listeners only respond to Escape to close modals/lightboxes (src/client/components/contextModal.tsx:83, src/client/components/images.tsx:72), do not record keystrokes, and have no clipboard or credential interface behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用注册外部子代理提供方的接口（无 registerProvider 调用），不涉及轮次委派到进程外产品。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call the interface to register external sub-agent providers (no registerProvider call), and does not involve round delegation to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 插件未使用 dsh 原生持驻机制（无 jobs.start 调用、无 schedule_create 或 create_goal/update_goal 注册调用），未监听轮次终止事件（无 agent/turn-stopping 监听）。工具来源标注文件中的 schedule/goal 字样仅为界面展示用静态映射（src/host/toolSources.ts:88-93），无任何注册调用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use dsh native persistent mechanisms (no jobs.start call, no schedule_create or create_goal/update_goal registration calls), and does not listen to turn termination events (no agent/turn-stopping listener). The words schedule/goal in the tool source annotation file are only static mapping for UI display (src/host/toolSources.ts:88-93), with no actual registration calls.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络请求目标：客户端仅有一个向 npm 官方仓库（registry.npmjs.org）及其备用镜像（registry.npmmirror.com）查询本插件最新版本号的请求（src/client/latestVersion.ts），用于插件信息卡片显示升级提示，1 小时缓存、失败静默降级、不含任何敏感数据。源码中其他网址均为文档链接或仓库元数据。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network request targets: the client only has one request to the official npm registry (registry.npmjs.org) and its mirror (registry.npmmirror.com) to query the latest version of this plugin (src/client/latestVersion.ts), used for update prompts on the plugin info card, with a 1-hour cache, silent fallback on failure, and containing no sensitive data. Other URLs in the source code are documentation links or repository metadata.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感信息后外发的链路，未发现向未知或裸 IP 端点发起的连接、隧道或带外通道。客户端对会话历史的读取走宿主标准接口、仅用于浏览器界面展示指定步骤内容。
checked_items.en: No chain of exfiltrating sensitive information after reading it was found, and no connections to unknown or bare IP endpoints, tunnels, or out-of-band channels were found. The client's reading of session history uses the host's standard interface, solely for displaying the specified step's content in the browser UI.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未注册自定义模型适配器（无 registerAdapter 调用），不存在 LLM 路由运行时劫持面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, and does not register a custom model adapter (no registerAdapter call), so there is no runtime hijacking surface for LLM routing.

checked_items.zh: 核对了插件身份：包名、仓库、作者一致，无仿冒同名包迹象。依赖均为官方与常见公开包（@deepseek-ai/cordis、zod、react 等），无 git 依赖（不存在未锁定提交的引用），无安装期执行钩子。工作区配置中的构建依赖放行（仅 esbuild）属开发仓库配置、不随插件发布。
checked_items.en: Verified the plugin identity: package name, repository, and author match, no signs of a similarly-named counterfeit package. Dependencies are all official and common public packages (@deepseek-ai/cordis, zod, react, etc.), no git dependencies (no un-pinned commit references), and no install-time execution hooks. The build dependency allowance (only esbuild) in the workspace configuration is a development repository configuration and is not published with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 补丁层仅插入自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未禁用任何安全行，未改写注入或拦截配置。未发现对审批类安全事件的优先监听。
checked_items.en: The patch layer only inserts its own entry, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable any security lines, and does not modify injection or interception configurations. No priority listening for approval-related security events was found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件只插入自身条目（cordis.patch.yml），未覆盖或禁用沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch file only inserts its own entry (cordis.patch.yml), and does not override or disable security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也不监听审批类安全事件，不存在截断审批链的优先监听。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools, and does not listen to approval-related security events, so there is no priority listener that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 对比上一版报告（0.37.0@6d17588a），本版本 manifest 声明（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client）与之前一致，未新增 dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service 声明，无升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: Compared with the previous version report (0.37.0@6d17588a), this version's manifest declarations (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client) are the same as before, with no new dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service declarations, and no risk of automatic activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写注入或拦截配置，未给安全插件追加服务导致永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch file does not modify injection or interception configurations, and does not add services to security plugins that would cause permanent waiting.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何本地 Web 服务、不监听端口，运行时不引入额外的本机无认证接口面。不注册后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标等 dsh 原生持驻机制。动态沙箱未启用（本次未做动态验证），运行时结论基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start any local web service, does not listen to any ports, and does not introduce additional native unauthenticated interface surfaces at runtime. It does not register background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals (dsh native persistent mechanisms). Dynamic sandbox is not enabled (no dynamic verification this time); runtime conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动本地 Web 服务、不监听端口，不新增本机无认证接口面。该场景针对启动服务的插件，本插件不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a local web service, does not listen to any ports, and does not add new native unauthenticated interface surfaces. This scenario applies to plugins that start a service; this plugin is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件身份与声明核验一致：包名/仓库/作者匹配，清单（package.json 的 dsh 声明与补丁文件）结构合法，无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: The plugin identity and declarations are verified consistent: package name/repository/author match, the manifest (dsh declarations in package.json and patch file) is structurally valid, with no signs of name spoofing.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中 10 条，经逐条人工复核全部为 CI 工作流、文档说明、开发辅助脚本、静态映射或良性界面行为，未构成风险。
summary.en: Static scan hit 10 items; after manual review of each item, all were confirmed to be CI workflows, documentation, development helper scripts, static mappings, or benign UI behavior, posing no risk.

summary.en: No install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reading, or abnormal outbound connections were found. The only outbound connection is the version check to the official npm registry and its mirror, which has been truthfully declared in the capability declaration.

summary.zh: 插件无模型可见工具描述与系统提示注入面。文档与命令文案未发现注入措辞。
summary.en: The plugin has no model-visible tool descriptions and no system prompt injection surface. No injection wording was found in the documentation or command text.

summary.zh: 本次未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed this time (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.en:
The plugin manifest (the dsh field in package.json) does not explicitly declare capability fields; the capability declarations in the report are filled based on code inspection: network capability is true (there is a version check request to the official npm registry), and all other capabilities are false.

Dynamic sandbox is not enabled (L4 = na), and runtime verification was not performed.

10 static pre-scan hits were all individually adjudicated (rule IDs are in each item):
(1) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml is a PR check CI (install dependencies, type check, test, build and bundle smoke), runs on GitHub infrastructure, not executed during plugin installation, it is a routine engineering practice, excluded.
(2) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: .github/workflows/release.yml is a CI workflow for the author to publish to npm (OIDC trusted publish, tag-triggered), runs on GitHub infrastructure, not executed during plugin installation, excluded.
(3) DSH-C05/DG-R4-53: In .oxlintrc.json:193, the code style rule name object-curly-spacing contains the substring "curl", which was falsely matched by the exfiltration pattern; it is not network behavior, excluded.
(4) DSH-X10/DG-R2-57: AGENTS.md is a development guide, its content is normal coding standards, build/test/release instructions, contains no injection wording, excluded.
(5) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55: scripts/bundle-smoke.mjs:58 uses new Function to run the bundled artifact in the test environment; it is a development helper script and is not in the published file list (publish only includes lib/client.js, lib/index.js, lib/index.d.ts, cordis.patch.yml, README.md, LICENSE), excluded.
(6) DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: src/client/components/contextModal.tsx:83 keyboard listener only closes the modal on Escape press, does not record keystrokes, excluded.
(7) DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: src/client/components/images.tsx:72 keyboard listener only closes the image lightbox on Escape press, does not record keystrokes, excluded.
(8) DSH-L05/DG-R3-63: In src/host/toolSources.ts:88, the word "schedule_create" is a static display mapping from tool to source plugin, with no actual scheduled task registration call, excluded.
(9) DSH-L05/DG-R3-63: In src/host/toolSources.ts:91, "create_goal" is the same kind of static mapping, with no persistent goal registration call, excluded.
(10) DSH-L05/DG-R3-63: In src/host/toolSources.ts:93, "update_goal" is the same kind of static mapping, excluded.

Compared with the previous version report (0.37.0@6d17588a), no new outbound targets, no new install hooks, no capability declaration upgrade, and no anomalous version signals.

Lock files, style sheets, and test files were covered by pattern scanning and not read verbatim; the remaining source files were read thoroughly. Plugin compatibility is based on static compatibility layer code (src/host/compat.ts) and development documentation declarations, and runtime verification was not performed.
